question: Can a version-isolated producer and an implementation-independent validator deterministically preserve pair identity, abstention semantics, and source-native translation-geometry metrics on a minimal burned real RGB-D/pose cohort?
non_goals: new evidence that fr2/rpy is rotation-dominant
confirmation, Kill Gate B, safety, product, Replay, Android, or human-subject claims

data_partitions.identity_basis: Official TUM fr2/rpy TGZ bound by the completed source-native geometry audit receipt and its archive SHA-256.

prior_evidence_bindings.access_disclosure: All ten fr2/rpy windows and their geometry outcomes were already accessed in Discovery. The canary cohort is intentionally outcome-informed and has implementation-readiness authority only.

canary_cohort.selection_rule: Use all three previously frozen rotation-dominant windows plus the only previously frozen window-level source-depth abstention; no other window may be added, substituted, shifted, or used to rescue a result.
canary_cohort.statistical_independence: Pairs and windows come from one sequence and are temporally dependent. They are engineering canary units, not independent scientific replicates.

interface_lock.producer_scope: A new version-isolated real_data_geometry_canary_r0 module may read only the bound TUM archive, the bound contract, and source-native RGB/depth/pose indexes. It may import the bound PB-H1 geometry primitive but must not import the prior TUM audit runner/module or read its result.json.
interface_lock.validator_scope: A separate validator must recompute association, pose interpolation, source-depth sampling, geometry, pair records, window summaries, and receipt checks from the bound raw archive. It must not import the producer or prior TUM audit implementation.
interface_lock.abstention_serialization: Every denominator pair emits the same key set. An abstaining row has exactly one enumerated abstention_reason and null for every unavailable metric; no key may be added, dropped, or renamed by branch.
interface_lock.float_mode: IEEE-754 float64 throughout geometry, interpolation, and aggregation.
interface_lock.publication_mode: One canonical output directory with pair_ledger.jsonl, window_summary.json, receipt.json, and validation.json. Design does not authorize creation of these outputs.

constraints.description: The archive, source-audit contract/result, and PB-H1 geometry implementation must match every bound SHA-256 before any canary decode or computation.
The canary producer may not read the prior audit result or use prior metric values as runtime inputs.
RGB may be inventoried by source index, but no RGB image may be decoded for RCLE, LK, optical-flow, local-affine, score, or candidate-outcome computation.
Exactly the four frozen canary windows must be emitted.
constraints.rationale: Prevents favorable window substitution and guarantees coverage of both the known evaluable and abstaining branches.
constraints.calibration_source: Completed fr2/rpy source-native audit: three rotation-dominant windows and one unique window-level depth-coverage abstention.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No 3-window or 5-window alternative is interpreted in R0; any changed cohort requires R1.
constraints.revision_policy: NEW_VERSION_ONLY; never revise after canary execution to rescue a mismatch.

constraints.description: The producer and validator must each emit every adjacent RGB pair in the frozen four-window denominator.
constraints.rationale: The earlier Bonn failure was hidden in abstaining records; preserving the full denominator prevents successful pairs from masking a branch mismatch.
constraints.calibration_source: Four windows times the frozen 299 adjacent RGB pairs per window in the accepted fr2/rpy audit.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report per-window counts. Any denominator change is a hard mismatch, not a tolerance question.
constraints.revision_policy: Immutable in R0; source timestamp or pairing changes require a new protocol version.

constraints.description: Producer and independent validator must agree on ordered pair identity for the entire denominator.
constraints.rationale: A numerical comparison is meaningless if implementations evaluate different timestamp pairs.
constraints.calibration_source: The governance requirement for source/content identity and the prior B1A ledger-identity failure.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No nonzero mismatch is allowed; additionally report the first mismatch and counts by window.
constraints.revision_policy: A mismatch closes only this evidence/implementation version; no post-result repair in place.

constraints.description: Every producer and validator pair row must have exactly the frozen key set, including abstaining rows.
constraints.rationale: Directly canaries the blank-branch serialization failure that invalidated Bonn B1A.
constraints.calibration_source: B1A closure learning record: 24 abstaining pairs produced 216 blank-grid key-set mismatches.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report mismatches separately for evaluable and abstaining rows; no aggregate rate may hide a mismatch.
constraints.revision_policy: The frozen schema cannot change in R0; a material schema correction requires R1 and preserves the R0 result.

constraints.description: Producer and independent validator must agree exactly on pair-level abstention reasons and window-level disposition.
constraints.rationale: Fail-closed missingness is part of the algorithm interface and cannot be treated as an optional diagnostic.
constraints.calibration_source: The accepted fr2/rpy audit, including window 4 SOURCE_DEPTH_COVERAGE_LT_0P50.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report pair reasons, window reasons, and nullability separately; any disagreement remains gating.
constraints.revision_policy: Reason enums and window disposition are immutable in R0.

constraints.description: No evaluable pair metric may exceed the frozen float64 absolute/relative comparison tolerances between producer and independent validator.
constraints.rationale: Verifies sign, unit, time normalization, pose interpolation, and aggregation without demanding byte-identical JSON floating-point text.
constraints.calibration_source: PB-H1 analytic fixture error below 1e-12 and deterministic same-environment fr2/rpy audit replay.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Primary tolerances are abs<=1e-12 or rel<=1e-10. Also report violation counts at abs<=1e-10 or rel<=1e-8; the relaxed report is diagnostic only.
constraints.revision_policy: Primary tolerance cannot be relaxed in R0. Cross-platform tolerance changes require a new protocol with evidence before execution.

constraints.description: The fixed cohort must exercise three evaluable window branches and one source-depth-coverage abstention branch with the frozen pair counts.
constraints.rationale: The canary is useful only if it actually exercises both successful geometry and fail-closed missing-data paths.
constraints.calibration_source: Prior accepted audit counts: windows 0/3/6 are 299/299 evaluable; window 4 is 293/299 pair-evaluable but window-abstains for median valid depth fraction 0.34125.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Counts are reported per window. No pooled 1190/1196 result can replace branch-level agreement.
constraints.revision_policy: Immutable in R0; changed source contents or association logic require a new evidence version.

constraints.description: Report the frozen continuous geometry metrics by window, but do not run p-values, bootstrap confidence intervals, or treat temporally adjacent pairs as independent replicates.

freeze.reason: Geometry outcome access already occurred during the source audit. This new canary freezes a distinct implementation-parity question and transparently burns the selected windows.

successor_policy.after_valid_pass: A separate task may review whether to preregister an RCLE RGB algorithm canary. No implementation or execution is automatically authorized.
successor_policy.after_valid_not_evaluable: Close only REAL-DATA-GEOMETRY-CANARY-R0. Preserve diagnostics and propose R1 only for a material interface or implementation change.
successor_policy.after_invalid: Close only this evidence version. Preserve the invalid output and repair execution only in a new evidence version if expected information gain justifies it.
never_granted: Replay, Android, human-subject, safety, or product authority

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Replay one deterministic four-window real cohort that contains all prior rotation-dominant windows and the only prior window-level depth abstention through a version-isolated producer and an implementation-independent validator.
experiment_design.resource_budget: One already-local official TUM archive, four fixed 10-second windows, 1196 pair records, no network access, no additional source, and no RCLE RGB algorithm output.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop before decode on any identity mismatch. During execution, finish the fixed denominator unless execution integrity is impossible; do not substitute windows or sources. Any gating mismatch closes only this implementation/evidence version.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Reuse the already-downloaded official archive and previously characterized branches. Use the smallest cohort that covers every known success role plus the unique window-level abstention path.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: The PB-H1 geometry formula is analytically calibrated, but the prior Bonn execution showed that correct-looking geometry is insufficient when producer and validator disagree on abstaining-record structure.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Tests a fixed, branch-complete real-data interface with an independent replay instead of another source search or algorithm outcome.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates source/geometry feasibility from implementation and serialization readiness before any RCLE RGB canary is considered.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Four fixed fr2/rpy windows: three evaluable rotation-dominant windows and one depth-coverage-abstaining window.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Exact source/cohort identity, pair denominator, ordered pair identity, record key set, abstention/window disposition, and float64 metric parity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any bound identity mismatch, omitted denominator record, schema mismatch, abstention mismatch, expected branch mismatch, or numeric parity violation.
hypotheses.resource_budget: One local archive, four windows, 1196 pair rows, one producer, and one independent validator.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Close R0 on the first validly established gating mismatch; do not tune tolerances, replace windows, or add a second source.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It directly targets the execution weakness exposed by B1A while using the smallest real cohort already shown to contain both evaluable and fail-closed branches.

failure_learning.observation: No canary implementation or execution has occurred.
failure_learning.inference: The protocol defines an implementation-readiness test only.
alternative_explanations: A future mismatch may arise from source parsing, association, pose interpolation, geometry math, aggregation, serialization, or validator independence.
constraint_challenges: No new scientific threshold is justified by this outcome-informed single-sequence canary.
next_hypotheses: If implementation parity passes, a separately preregistered RGB algorithm canary may test rotation suppression without treating these windows as confirmation.
failure_learning.information_gain: Execution will show whether the real-data geometry interface is trustworthy enough to support a later, separately governed algorithm canary.

new_facts_and_evidence: None; this is a design-only preregistration.
unresolved_questions: Whether an independent implementation can reproduce every real-data pair and abstention branch.
Whether RCLE RGB compensation suppresses rotation-induced apparent expansion on real data.
next_high_information_experiments: Only after separate authorization: implement and review the frozen geometry canary without running RCLE RGB outcomes.
